title: Design System: Pot Plant Heaven Perth

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Uppercase white with the second word in flash; width 68% below 901px, 76% above.

title.purpose: Plant common names on tags; sheet, step, FAQ and order titles. Uppercase.

price.purpose: Every price, subtotal and total; tabular figures.

quote.purpose: Stephen's quote in the story section only.

botanical.purpose: Italic Latin names under common names; never caps.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked names for fields, facts and footer columns; never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: tag-rest
shadows.purpose: Every tag; applied as filter so the stake and hole silhouettes cast.

shadows.name: punched-hole
shadows.purpose: The punched hole in every tag.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Sheets, menus, button press, meter fill, photo zoom.

motion.name: ease-pull
motion.purpose: Tag lift-and-straighten, add-button press, order-button bump.

motion.name: tag-lift
motion.purpose: A tag pulled from the bed on hover or focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms; 3D bench replaced by a flat tag

narrative.overview:
Every plant is its own white injection-moulded stake label pushed into a saturated nursery-green bed. The tag is the one object the system is built from: it is the catalogue card, the plant detail sheet (front and back), the hero's 3D label, each line of the order, and even the search box. Each carries a punched hole, rounded shoulders and either a pointed stake below (vertical tags) or a stake to the left (horizontal tags). The page reads as a working nursery bench, not a lifestyle boutique.

Density is high and honest. Hundreds of tags sit in a grid with real photos, pot sizes and prices, and nothing is hidden behind hover. Type is one variable family, Archivo, pulled hard to its narrowest width for names and numbers so long plant names and prices stay big. Process-yellow marks money and the primary action. Signal red appears only when something is out of stock or wrong. Black poly-pot plastic is the deepest ground.

Motion follows the physical tag. Tags rest at a slight tilt and lift upright when you reach for them, sheets arrive with a small settle, and nothing loops or bounces. Under reduced motion, transitions collapse to nothing and the 3D bench gives way to a flat tag.
keyCharacteristics: One object, many jobs: the stake tag is the card, the sheet, the order line and the search field.
Saturated nursery-green field (never white) as the page ground.
Black condensed caps for names, italic for botanicals, yellow flash for prices.
Soft, physical drop shadows under the tags; no flat-UI borders around cards.
Pill-shaped controls throughout; tag silhouettes reserved for content objects.

rules.name: The Flash Means Money Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks price and the act of buying (price bands, subtotals, primary add/send actions, selected size). It never decorates a heading block or a section background.

rules.name: The Red Is a Warning Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for out-of-stock, invalid input and error status. It is never an accent.

rules.name: The Green Ground Rule
rules.body: Content sits on the green field or on a white tag, never on a white page. White surfaces are always objects with a tag silhouette, a sheet or a field.

rules.name: The Printed Tag Rule
rules.body: Plant names, prices and section heads are uppercase, weight 900, width 62%. Botanical names are italic, never caps. Prices always use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Label Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase labels name a field, a fact or a column. They are never a decorative kicker stacked above a heading.

rules.name: The Plastic Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and tinted toward the green bed, as if the tag were lifted off it. Never use a hard offset shadow.

dos: **Do** build every new content object as a tag: rounded shoulders, punched hole, stake, and the tag-rest shadow.
**Do** set names, prices and section heads in Archivo 900 at width 62%, uppercase, with tabular figures on every number.
**Do** put prices on the flash band and keep flash for money, buying and focus.
**Do** keep controls as pills (999px) at 44 to 48px tall, and circles for icon buttons.
**Do** use the drawn 24px / 1.75-stroke icon family for any new glyph.
**Do** let tags tilt at rest and straighten on hover or focus, using the pull curve (cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)), and collapse motion under reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** put content on a white page. The ground is the green field, deep green or pot black.
**Don't** use red for anything except out-of-stock, invalid input or errors.
**Don't** give a content card plain uniform corners or a 1px border in place of the tag silhouette.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows. Tag shadows stay soft and green-tinted.
**Don't** put tracked uppercase kickers or eyebrows above headings. Tracked labels name fields and facts only.
**Don't** set botanical names in caps or plant common names in sentence case.
